Related to BUG-1290 source-scan safety but distinct: this is deterministic completion-time failure. Fix must preserve canonical content/hash accuracy, fail-closed semantics, candidate-only isolation and bounded memory, while removing pathological repeated query overhead. Do not add resource or approval gates, do not change production data, and do not interrupt the active evidence run.
